description_en: Queries the live center stream relay configuration by calling DescribeLiveCenterTransfer
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveCenterTransfer查询直播中心转推配置
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveCenterTransfer

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must match the AppName of the live stream to be relayed for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The third-party live streaming URL to which the stream is relayed
parameters.help_zh: 转推的第三方直播地址
parameters.name: dst_url

LiveCenterTransferInfo.description_en: The list of live stream relay services

items.description_en: The list of live stream relay services

AppName.description_en: The name of the live stream application

DstUrl.description_en: The third-party live streaming URL to which the stream is relayed
DstUrl.description_zh: 转推的第三方直播地址

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the stream relay. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC+0
EndTime.description_zh: 转推结束时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the stream relay. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC+0
StartTime.description_zh: 转推开始时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

StreamName.description_en: The name of the live stream

TransferArgs.description_en:
The validity period of the stream relay. Valid values:

always: permanently effective.

time: effective within the specified time range
TransferArgs.description_zh:
转推有效时间。取值：

always：永久生效。

time：指定时间内有效
